one_line: The underlying computed negative SIGNAL (candidate ties the strongest fair baseline; delta=0.0; gates are fail-able; fully reproducible) is genuine, but the REPORTED close_or_downgrade is packaged with a hardcoded result.json verdict, a self-reported access-parity gate on the declared causal path, and several non-fail-able / hand-filled controls; these must be repaired before the bundle is admitted as clean computed negative evidence.

core_finding.explanation: candidate_policy and fair_interventional_baseline.exhaustive_legal_query both call query_all_policy(episode) with the default order and query the entire legal action space (budget=item_count=8=all items), so both recover the exact hidden set -> score 1.0. delta=0.0 is structural, not coincidental. This is genuine baseline equivalence and the honest negative outcome for THIS candidate implementation.
core_finding.scorer_is_discriminative: passive/observation-only baselines genuinely score 0.16-0.40 (<1.0); ablations score 0.20-1.00; only the query-based candidate and the 12 fair/graph-cache interventional baselines reach 1.0. The scorer is real, not pinned to 1.0.
core_finding.computed_gates_are_fail_able: Fail-ability probe (monkeypatched all baselines to score 0.0, candidate stays 1.0, delta=1.0): baseline_comparison.margin_decision flipped to candidate_margin_cleared, saturation_decision flipped to not_saturated, failure_manifest.stop_conditions became []. The computed gates respond correctly to inputs.

1_cli_recomputes_everything.evidence: Fresh CLI run exit 0; pytest 4 passed; trace.jsonl & baseline_comparison.json byte-identical to committed after CRLF->LF normalization (only predeclaration_hash and source_artifact_sha256 differ, both downstream of source_artifact CRLF). Provenance 115 rows produced by callable paths.

2_exhaustive_legal_query_is_fair_baselin.evidence: It is code-identical to the candidate (same query_all_policy, same default order), so access is provably equal; it is a fair, indeed maximally-fair, interventional baseline.

3_access_parity_computed_not_self_report.evidence: build_access_parity_report() takes NO candidate/baseline access traces (signature: repo_root, output_dir, run_id, code_hash, source_hash). It emits a static dict with every dimension candidate_access/baseline_access='legal_equal', parity=true, verdict='access_parity_passed'. Pure self-report. Tests assert all(item['parity'] is True) — locks the literal.

4_saturation_control_consumes_report_and.evidence: saturation_failing_negative_control.json sets access_parity_report_consumed:true as a LITERAL field and calls saturation_gate(candidate=1.0, fair=1.0, parity=True) with hardcoded inputs identical to the real run. It does NOT actually read access_parity_report.json, and only re-exhibits the SATURATED (close_or_downgrade) branch; it never demonstrates not_saturated. Consumption is asserted, not real; control is not fail-able in the discriminating direction.

5_margin_failing_control_fails_closed.evidence: margin_failing_negative_control.json: candidate=0.50, baseline=0.49, advantage=0.01 -> clears=false -> close_or_downgrade. Genuinely fails closed via the same margin_gate callable. (Bundle lacks an in-bundle cleared demonstration; supplied by audit probe.)

6_replay_recomputes_from_state_not_hashe.evidence: recompute_replay...() genuinely recomputes predicted set from legal_history membership (all 5 match; independently reproduced from trace). stored_hash_only_used=false is true. CAVEAT: the controls{corrupted_state, missing_observation, forbidden_truth_field_read}='fail_closed' are HARDCODED literals — the failing conditions are never executed through the replay function.

7_ablations_real_intervention.evidence: run_ablation_reruns() rebuilds episodes and recomputes predictions under modified policies; scores vary (0.20-1.00) across ablations and seeds. replace_candidate_policy_with_strongest_fair_baseline_policy -> 1.0 = candidate score, corroborating baseline equivalence by computation.

8_leakage_positive_controls_detected.evidence: All 11 detect_leakage positive controls return detected=true via the real detector. CAVEAT: payloads are constructed to match each detector (near-tautological); the scanner is NEVER run over the actual produced artifacts (result.json, trace.jsonl, serialized_state) and there is no clean-negative control showing not-detected on the real pipeline. Not a fail-able guard over the real evidence.

9_source_pin_not_only_fuse_truncation_vu.evidence: read_file_pin() does a pathlib double-read (catches only between-read staleness) and HARDCODES prefix_truncation_detected=false; shell_mount_read_compared=false. No independent reader / expected-size comparison, so it cannot actually detect prefix truncation; it asserts absence. (No actual truncation present here: runner.py sha256 matches committed code_path_hash e07980a4.)

10_provenance_rows_callable_and_complete.evidence: 115 rows, 0 missing required fields; 8 roles {candidate, passive baseline, fair interventional baseline, control, gate, ablation, replay, leakage}; 31 producer_functions; all code_path_hash==e07980a4 (real runner hash); all have recompute_command and source_pinned_input_artifact_hash. 11_no_literal_or_result_patching_creates.evidence: result.json['verdict']='close_or_downgrade' and ['terminal_reason']='strongest_fair_baseline_saturated_candidate' are HARDCODED string constants (runner.py lines 1328-1329), NOT derived from the computed gates. Fail-ability probe proved it: when computed gates flip to candidate-wins, result.json STILL reports close_or_downgrade and stop_conditions=[] (internal inconsistency with failure_manifest). access_parity_report, saturation control, and replay sub-controls are also hand-filled clean reports. The valid computed negative evidence lives ONLY in baseline_comparison.json / failure_manifest.stop_conditions, not in the reported result.json headline.

12_no_forbidden_scope_changes.evidence: Harness writes only under output_dir (code-verified); git usage is read-only (rev-parse/branch/status only — no commit/push/tag/add/remote/anchor); task outputs are untracked (?? in run-time git_readback); no mainline/runtime/bridge/scheduler/Gate-runner/product source has a post-2026-06-16 mtime attributable to this harness. auto_remote_anchor='forbidden' preserved.

blocking_issues: B1 (check 11): result.json verdict + terminal_reason are non-computed literals, disconnected from the gates (proven fail-ability probe). The REPORTED close_or_downgrade is not itself computed/fail-able.

B2 (check 3): access parity is self-reported (static all-true dict, no access traces consumed); the declared terminal_reason (saturation) consumes this hand-filled parity as a hardcoded-True conjunct.
B3 (check 4): saturation 'failing negative control' does not actually consume access_parity_report.json and never exhibits not_saturated; it is not fail-able in the discriminating direction.
B4 (check 9): source-pin readback hardcodes prefix_truncation_detected=false and performs no independent-reader/expected-size truncation check.
non_blocking_issues: N1 (check 6): replay sub-controls (corrupted_state/missing_observation/forbidden_truth) are hardcoded fail_closed literals, not executed (main replay recomputation is genuine).
N2 (check 8): leakage scanner only confirms planted, detector-matched positives; never scans real artifacts; no clean-negative control.
N3: test suite asserts the literal outcomes (verdict=='close_or_downgrade', delta==0.0, parity all true) rather than fail-ability; it is a fixture, not a falsification test.
N4 (env): cross-environment reproducibility uses CRLF source_artifact on Windows -> source/predeclaration hashes are line-ending-dependent; LF rerun changes those hashes only.
N5 (env): in a broken-git environment forbidden_scope_status returns clean vacuously (empty status); independent filesystem check used here instead.
required_fixes_for_admission: Derive result.json['verdict'] and ['terminal_reason'] from baseline_comparison gate verdicts (margin_decision/saturation_decision) and add an assertion that result.verdict == the computed gate outcome; fail the run on mismatch.

Compute access parity from recorded candidate/baseline access traces (API set, budget used, observation set, state/update access, cache) and make build_access_parity_report fail when access differs; feed the COMPUTED parity into saturation_gate.

Replace the hardcoded saturation/replay negative controls with controls that actually execute the failing/clearing inputs through the same callables and produce both close_or_downgrade AND not_saturated/cleared outcomes (in-bundle fail-ability in both directions).
Run the leakage scanner over the actual produced artifacts plus a clean-negative control; record not-detected on the real pipeline.
Implement a real source-pin truncation check (independent reader / expected-size or known-good hash comparison) instead of asserting prefix_truncation_detected=false.
Make tests assert fail-ability (e.g., a perturbed candidate flips the gate verdict) rather than only locking literals.
